title: When searchBox is inside a <form>, <button type="reset"> has no effect

comments.body: Pressing 'esc' fire the event so, I think it's just a matter of type of event watched by instantsearch, it's probably 'input' and should be 'change'
When using url sync it seems that the reset event won't be enough because it reset to the value of the form when loading the page.
This should be solved by doing https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/issues/859.
